narrator: Dr. Seward, Mina Harker, Jonathan Harker (diaries)
summary: On the train from Varna to Galatz Mina's trances grow harder; she reports a still ship, oars, a gun, and then 'something going out' with wolves and falling water. At Galatz the party boards the Czarina Catherine and Captain Donelson tells of the unnaturally fast fog-wrapped voyage, his Roumanian sailors' fear of the box and the handspike argument. They trace the box through Immanuel Hildesheim to the Slovak agent Petrof Skinsky, who is found dead with a torn throat in St. Peter's churchyard. Mina, studying the typescripts and maps, writes a Memorandum deducing the Count must travel upriver by an open boat on the Sereth then Bistritza toward the Borgo Pass. The party splits: Godalming and Jonathan by steam launch, Seward and Morris on horseback along the bank, Van Helsing and Mina by train and carriage to the Borgo Pass and the castle. Diaries record the chase, the launch accident at the rapids, snow threatening, and Mina's trance power fading.

scenes.title: Failing Trances on the Train
scenes.summary: Mina's reports: still water against the hawser, men calling, oars, a gun, light and wind; later cold wind passing and wolves; at dawn cattle lowing. Each trance is harder; sunrise cuts her off mid-sentence.
scenes.key_quote: Something is going out; I can feel it pass me like a cold wind.

scenes.title: Captain Donelson's Tale
scenes.location: Aboard the Czarina Catherine, anchored in the river harbour at Galatz
scenes.summary: The Scots captain describes the fog that travelled with the ship, the superstitious Roumanian crew making the sign against the evil eye at the old man who loaded the box, his handspike quelling the mutiny, and the receiver arriving before sun-up with papers for Count Dracula.
scenes.key_quote: It’s no canny to run frae London to the Black Sea wi’ a wind ahint ye, as though the Deil himself were blawin’ on yer sail

scenes.title: Hildesheim and Skinsky
scenes.location: Hildesheim's office, Burgen-strasse 16; Skinsky's neighbourhood; St. Peter's churchyard wall
scenes.summary: Bribed, Hildesheim reveals a letter from Mr. de Ville; box given to Skinsky; paid by English bank note cashed at the Danube International Bank. Skinsky has left, key and rent sent by messenger; his body is found with throat torn open.
scenes.key_quote: the body of Skinsky had been found inside the wall of the churchyard of St. Peter, and that the throat had been torn open as if by some wild animal.

scenes.title: Mina's Memorandum
scenes.summary: While the men rest, Mina types up everything, studies maps and writes a memorandum by exclusion (road, rail, water) concluding the Count goes by water upriver, probably the Sereth then the Bistritza near Fundu.
scenes.key_quote: We know from the record that he was on the water; so what we have to do is to ascertain what water.

scenes.title: Council of War
scenes.summary: Party divides: launch, horsemen, and Van Helsing with Mina through Bistritz and the Borgo Pass to the castle. Jonathan protests passionately, then yields. Money produces launch, horses, maps within three hours.
scenes.key_quote: Not for the world! Not for Heaven or Hell!

scenes.title: Steam Launch Pursuit
scenes.summary: They steam night and day, overhaul every boat, fly a Roumanian flag at Fundu to be treated as officials, and are delayed by a rapids accident.
scenes.key_quote: The men were scared every time we turned our electric lamp on them, and fell on their knees and prayed.

scenes.title: Horseback Along the Bank
scenes.summary: Three days on the road, news at Fundu that the launch went up the Bistritza, snow threatens; they would take a sledge if needed.
scenes.key_quote: In such case we must get a sledge and go on, Russian fashion.

scenes.title: Veresti Departure
scenes.summary: Van Helsing buys carriage, horses and furs; landlady packs a huge provision basket. Mina writes a farewell thought to Jonathan.
scenes.key_quote: We are truly in the hands of God.

creatures.name: Count Dracula (on river in box)
creatures.description: Helpless in earth-box carried on an open boat by Slovaks.
creatures.behaviour: Murdered Skinsky; avoided customs; summons fog and storm at night.
weaknesses: running water would engulf him if wrecked
dependent on carriers who might throw him in the river
creatures.quote: On the water he is powerless except at night; even then he can only summon fog and storm and snow and his wolves.

vampire_lore.detail: Fog fell on the ship and travelled with it for five days, giving a favourable wind and fast passage.
vampire_lore.quote: a fog fell on us and travelled wi’ us

vampire_lore.detail: Roumanian sailors put out two fingers at the old man who loaded the box.
vampire_lore.quote: put out their twa fingers when they saw him, to guard against the evil eye.

vampire_lore.rule: Count powerless by water in day
vampire_lore.detail: On water he is helpless except at night, can summon fog, storm, snow, wolves.
vampire_lore.quote: he can only summon fog and storm and snow and his wolves.

vampire_lore.rule: Wrecked in running water he'd be lost
vampire_lore.quote: the living water would engulf him, helpless

vampire_lore.rule: Cannot leave box in day without risking carriers
vampire_lore.detail: If carriers suspect they would throw him in the stream.
vampire_lore.quote: he may not leave his box lest those who carry him may suspect

vampire_lore.detail: Mina's trance grows hard; at dawn the sun forces her out.
vampire_lore.quote: the risen sun was reddening even Mrs. Harker’s pale face.

vampire_lore.rule: Mina's scar forbids carrying a holy weapon
vampire_lore.detail: She cannot carry the same arms as others.
vampire_lore.quote: the scar on my forehead forbids that.

vampire_lore.rule: Count needs to be carried to land
vampire_lore.detail: If not carried ashore at night he can fly or jump; else lose the day.
vampire_lore.quote: he can jump or fly on shore, as he did at Whitby.

puzzles.name: Trace the box through Galatz
puzzles.setup: Box left the ship before dawn.
puzzles.obstacle: Chain of agents: Captain, Hildesheim, Skinsky.
puzzles.book_solution: Follow receipt to Hildesheim, bribe him, learn of Skinsky, find the body.
puzzles.game_idea: Investigation chain: collect names and addresses by bribery to open each next location; time limit before witnesses close ranks.
puzzles.quote: His arguments were pointed with specie—we doing the punctuation

puzzles.name: Mina's Memorandum by exclusion
puzzles.setup: Count has left Galatz in the box.
puzzles.book_solution: Eliminate road and rail, use trance sounds (cattle, oars, creaking wood, water level with ears) to infer an open boat going upstream on Sereth/Bistritza.
puzzles.game_idea: Deduction puzzle: match sound clues against map features to choose the river route.
puzzles.quote: There would be no such sound if floating down stream.

puzzles.name: Find the boat
puzzles.book_solution: Fly the Roumanian flag to be treated as officials and search every boat.
puzzles.game_idea: Boat-inspection mini-game: search cargo of each boat with limited time, use bluff.
puzzles.quote: With every boat which we have over-hauled since then this trick has succeeded

puzzles.name: Rapids
puzzles.setup: Launch tries to force a way up rapids.
puzzles.book_solution: Godalming repairs; local help and rope.
puzzles.quote: The Slovak boats get up all right, by aid of a rope and steering with knowledge.

combat.name: Handspike mutiny
combat.tactics: Captain faces down the sailors who tried to throw the box overboard.
combat.game_idea: Optional flashback tutorial: crowd control with a single blunt weapon.
combat.quote: when the last o’ them rose off the deck wi’ his head in his hand

quest_hooks: Investigate the Galatz paper trail: Captain, Hildesheim, Skinsky's neighbours, the churchyard body.
Decide the party split and who accompanies Mina; consequences differ per choice.
River chase: control the launch, keep the furnace fed, search boats, and use the flag trick.
Mounted route-clearing along the bank and tracking the launch with local rumours.
Interrogate Mina in trances with a diminishing number of usable sessions.
